ex_desc_1: Keep your frequently used code at your fingertips.
ex_desc_2: Stay organized with smart and intuitive categorization.
ex_desc_3: Find the exact snippet you need—instantly.
question: Sounds familiar?
quote: "Ugh, where did I write that code again...?"
no_more_searching: No more digging through folders for your code.
intro_text: Save your favorite snippets as templates and access them in a flash with CodeZap.
template_explanation_1: In CodeZap, templates are reusable bundles of code you often write.
template_explanation_2: You can include multiple snippets in one template for better organization.
source_code_explanation_1: A snippet in CodeZap is a unit of code made of a filename and the content itself.
source_code_explanation_2: Name your file with an extension to enable syntax highlighting and easy copying.
target_title: CodeZap is made for you if you...
target_1: Want to quickly save and reuse your go-to snippets
target_2: Hate hunting through old files to find that one line of code
target_3: Want to finally organize your code but don’t know where to start
